title: The Library Book Set Aside
youtube_title: The Library Book Set Aside | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Greta notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a library book set aside with a paper ribbon. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Greta does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
